A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same prompt-complexity study. The main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices A–H can be matched reliably, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original Gaussian-mixture experiments, T2I evaluations on CC12M, ImageNet-1k and DCI, and a human diversity study with 900 pairwise judgments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds human validation of DSG and confidence-interval analyses in Appendices E.2 and G.3.

M1.justification: The captioning, pairing, alignment, sampling and generation framework, including Algorithm 1, is unchanged. Guidance and prompt-expansion procedures are retained. Newly disclosed DSG implementation details do not establish a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Gaussian toy setting and CC12M, ImageNet-1k and DCI prompt-complexity tasks. The added human checks validate the existing consistency metric; they introduce no new generation domain or input scenario.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same LDM variants, Flux-schnell and Infinity, together with the same CFG, APG, CADS, interval-guidance and prompt-expansion configurations. Human reference scores validate DSG rather than introduce a generative baseline.

E3.justification: Appendix E.2 adds protocols for checking question decomposition with four annotators assessing 25 prompts each, and VQA answers with ten annotators assessing 50 DCI images each. Existing generation settings and sample budgets are retained. Table 7 inconsistently totals 510 samples rather than the stated 500.

E4.justification: v2 adds focused human validation of both DSG stages: whether decomposed questions are valid and whether automated image-question answers agree with humans. The existing Vendi validation, guidance-scale analyses, model comparisons and qualitative cases remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix G.3 and Tables 8–10 introduce systematic 95% confidence intervals across 5,000 CC12M prompts for all three reference-free metrics, two models and five sampling configurations. v1 reports no such intervals. This substantially expands uncertainty reporting without establishing additional runs or seeds.

E6.justification: New DSG-validation outcomes include 95.54% valid decompositions and Table 7's human-versus-VQA scores, with Pearson correlation 0.89 and R² 0.68. Tables 8–10 explicitly tabulate CC12M estimates and intervals. Existing benchmark curves and Table 6's diversity judgments are retained.

T1.justification: Appendix A.2 corrects score-function derivatives from gradients with respect to model parameters θ to gradients with respect to the noisy input x_t, including Equations 8–9 and 12–15. The underlying AND/OR derivations remain otherwise unchanged; no new proof is added.

C1.justification: The revised introduction and conclusion explicitly suggest an inherent diversity lower bound and frame reference-free metric optimization as potentially harming distributional fidelity. These refine and strengthen interpretations of retained findings; the abstract and overall research contributions remain stable.

C2.justification: New Appendices A.3 and G.2 substantially expand applicability and limitations: correlated text embeddings make the idealized composition rule heuristic, ImageNet specificity differs from token composition, and prompt expansion can amplify biases or override user intent. Creative and OOD-training applications are also discussed, without new downstream experiments.

D1.justification: Appendix E.2 newly identifies Gemma-3-27B-Instruct as the DSG question generator and documents the annotation workflow. A reproducibility statement adds a supplementary review-code availability claim. Existing captioning and expansion models, hyperparameters, hardware information and public code URL are retained.

R1.justification: v2 removes the ImagenHub citation by Ku et al. and GenAI Arena citation by Jiang et al., together with a malformed introductory fragment. The dedicated related-work discussion and broader positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction and conclusion receive localized rewrites, the broken introductory fragment is removed, and appendix subsections and a reproducibility statement are added. Author-name and acknowledgment text also change. The overall narrative and main section order are preserved.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 7–10, replaces the illustrative animal images in Figure 1a, and reflows appendix figures and tables. Existing plotted results and qualitative grids are retained. The expanded contents list spills onto a largely empty additional page.

improvement.justification: DSG human validation, uncertainty reporting, corrected score derivatives and clearer theoretical qualifications provide a limited overall improvement. Reporting flaws temper these gains: G.3's blanket non-overlap claim is contradicted by Table 9, including APG complexity levels 2 and 3, and Table 7 totals 510 samples despite the stated 500. The central experimental evidence remains unchanged.
